versions.subject: add process_creation_conti_cmd_ransomware.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '-m '
        - '-net '
        - '-size ' #size 10 in references
        - '-nomutex '
        - '-p \\'
        - '$'
condition: selection
versions.spl: CommandLine="*-m *" CommandLine="*-net *" CommandLine="*-size *" CommandLine="*-nomutex *" CommandLine="*-p \\*" CommandLine="*$*"
